script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Saltec International se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se call kar raha hoon — dekh raha hoon ki aapka account kaafi purana hai, lagbhag 26 saal se aap hamare saath hain, lekin pichle 30 dinon mein platform pe zero login activity hai — toh seedha poochh raha hoon, kya koi specific issue aa rahi hai?
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, aapke paas 3 buyer leads — jo hum 'Business Leads' kehte hain — aaye hain recently, aur unka reply rate abhi zero percent hai — kya aapko in leads ki notifications mil rahi thi, ya koi technical problem thi login mein, ya phir leads ki quality se koi disappointment tha?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karna chahta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 56 hai, jo 60 se neeche hai, iska matlab buyers jab search karte hain toh aapka catalog unhe properly visible nahi hota; aur demand tier abhi Red zone mein hai, matlab market mein competition tight hai — aise mein agar reply rate zero rahe toh jo bhi organic visibility bachi hai, woh bhi drop hoti hai.
script_parts.action: Toh abhi is call pe, main aapko aapka account open karwa ke sirf ek kaam karwata hoon — un 3 unanswered Business Leads ko saath mein dekh ke ek quick reply template set kar dete hain, 2 minute ka kaam hai, aur main guide karta hoon step by step.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, aaj sirf yeh ek reply bhej dein un leads ko — baaki CQS improvement aur catalog updates ke liye main agle 2 dinon mein ek short follow-up call karoonga, koi pressure nahi, bas yeh ek step aaj complete kar lein, theek hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Saltec International? This is calling from IndiaMART — I can see your account is nearly 26 years old with us, but in the last 30 days there has been zero login activity on the platform, so I wanted to reach out directly and understand if there's a specific issue.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Sir, you have 3 Business Leads that came in recently and the reply rate on those is currently zero percent — I wanted to ask, were you receiving the lead notifications, was there a technical difficulty logging in, or was there some disappointment with the quality of those leads?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's something important to flag — your CQS score is currently 56, which is below the 60 threshold, meaning your catalog is not surfacing prominently in buyer searches; additionally, your demand tier is Red, indicating a flat and competitive market — in this environment, a zero reply rate further erodes whatever organic visibility remains on your account.
script_parts_en.action: What I'd like us to do right now, together on this call, is open your account and take just 2 minutes to look at those 3 unanswered Business Leads and set up a quick reply — I'll guide you through each step so we can get at least one response sent before we hang up.
script_parts_en.close: Sir, just this one action today — reply to those leads — and I'll schedule a short follow-up call within 2 days to work on your CQS and catalog visibility; no pressure beyond that, just let's close this one step right now — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
